classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Defense is directed to take appropriate enforcement steps, but the provision leaves the particular measures and their implementation to executive discretion rather than itself changing legal status or dictating a specified later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Defense is authorized and directed to take all appropriate steps

classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Defense receives discretionary authority to decide whether and to what extent Armed Forces are necessary; any operational consequences occur through his later implementation.

classifications.evidence: as he may deem appropriate to carry out the purposes of this order

classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Defense is granted discretionary operational authority to use units and members after they have been called into active service, without a mandated use or specified legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Defense is authorized to use the units, and members thereof
